Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People & Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 10+ years’ experience in Strong software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Job Summary

As an Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing delivery of high-quality, innovative products and solutions. Your role will involve strategic planning, technical leadership, and ensuring that projects are completed on time and within budget. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and operations, to drive the development of scalable and reliable systems.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities

This position’s main responsibility is to lead AI strategy and execution within Wealth Retail Banking Tech. The Engineering Lead will drive end-to-end implementation of AI solutions— provide engineering solution by working with cross functional team on identified use cases, shaping the technical roadmap on AI Adoption across wealth solutions.

Skills Set

We are seeking someone with direct experience designing and deploying AI and machine learning solutions at scale. Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages, familiarity with data engineering and model development frameworks, and experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) are required. Leadership in AI projects, knowledge of MLOps, and a proven track record of integrating AI into customer-facing products are essential. Familiar with open source AI toolkit such as Claude, Co-pilot etc.

Result

The expected outcomes are clear: deliver measurable business value through AI-driven solutions—enhanced customer insights, process automation, and new product features powered by machine learning. We expect improvements in efficiency, customer experience, and innovation from embedding AI into our technology landscape.

Processes

  • Improve engineering processes to drive efficiency and collaboration.
  • Analyse and mitigate dependencies to enable quality and speed of delivery.
  • Drive solution standardization and service reusability.
  • Define frameworks and standards for product.
  • Actively contribute to process improvement and innovation
  • Collaborate with IT Change and Release Managers to develop strategic delivery and release plans with technical dependencies.
  • Ensure high-level technical consistency of solution with business and enterprise technology standards.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence within squads.

People & Talent

  • Able to work with cross functional team.
  • Able to influence technical adoption by squad teams

Risk Management

  • Mitigate technical risks and ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with application security and regulatory standards.
  • Manage technical risks throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Support required solution to achieve ERR Treatment plan
  • Proactively identify and address potential risks.
  • Ensure compliance with bank compliance guidelines & standards (e.g. data protection)

Governance

  • Ensure product and solution development is aligned with enterprise architecture and standards.
  • Maintain consistency in technical practices across squads.
  • Lead governance of application/platform-specific technical standards.
  • Address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Represent sub domain in relevant architecture forum and drive vendor solutions in accordance with organizational standards.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Domain Tech Lead
  • Chief Product Owner / Product Owners
  • Architecture Team
  • Release Managers

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Wealth Journey squad; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

Skills And Experience

Application Delivery Process

  • Proven experience in managing and delivering complex technical projects in an enterprise environment.
  • Ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring quality and timely delivery.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience with Agile and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies.
  • Capability to coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Specific examples of past project management successes, demonstrating effective leadership and delivery.

Technical Skills

  • Strong engineering background with extensive experience in delivering high-quality technical solutions in an enterprise environment.
  • Ability to interact with APIs, databases, and other technical components.
  • Proficiency in understanding code and its implications on the system, enabling effective technical conversations and decision-making.
  • Knowledge of modern software development practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

Problem Solving

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills honed through years of practical experience in the field.
  • Ability to think critically and make sound technical decisions under pressure.
  • Experience in identifying, diagnosing, and addressing complex technical problems.
  • Capability to balance short-term fixes with long-term solutions, leveraging past experiences to guide decisions.

Technical Aptitude

  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and best practices in architecture.
  • Ability to design scalable, reliable, and secure solutions based on extensive industry experience.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, version control systems).
  • Experience in setting up and maintaining engineering practices to high standards, with tangible examples from previous roles.
  • Ability to drive technical conversations and provide mentorship based on a wealth of practical experience.

Others

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, crucial for effective interaction in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Effective stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience in documenting technical designs and solutions for a range of audiences.
  • Ability to articulate complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Certifications: Relevant certifications in software development, project management, or Agile methodologies (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, PMP, Certified ScrumMaster)

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Branch VRM has a central role to play in effectively implementing change as an integral part of delivering the whole WPB business strategy.

The role is a customer facing where leadership and meeting customer needs are critical to the success of the business. The role is to directly manage a portfolio of International Clients and build quality customer relationship via professional service and needs fulfillment.

The role shall support Branch Manager in delivering up-to-standard business requirement, customer satisfaction and quality control.

This will be achieved by active management of a portfolio of Premier clients, acquiring new HSBC clients and upgrading existing clients through becoming the trusted advisor to them. It will also entail reviewing the portfolio regularly to ensure the solutions are still suitable to meet clients’ needs and embed client loyalty by meeting their needs either directly or through other internal business partners.

In order to deliver the business objectives you will need to refer non-qualified business to appropriate parties following proposition protocol and attract business with new clients by understanding their financial needs and delivering high standards of service quality and complete simple retail sales. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals.

In delivering the business objectives you must also maintain the levels of operational integrity required by HSBC Group, closely managing your individual and the collective performance of your wider team. Creating and maintaining an environment and relationships where you and the wider Branch team maximise performance in achieving the IWPB business objectives.

The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.

The role is accountable for the performance of your portfolio and need to ensure it is effectively run managing to the Target Operating Model (TOM) as defined by HSBC Group.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Knowledge & Experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Minimum of three years proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent

Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products

Relationship management experience with high net worth clients

Strong technical skills in wealth management

Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills

Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills

Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system

Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services

Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by HBCN

Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment

Able to communicate well in English and local languages

  • Accreditations

Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market.

Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

  • Leadership Capabilities

Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly

Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients

Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity

Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace

Make considered decisions that protect HSBC & Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses

Job Summary

The “Chapter Lead - Chapter Lead, Front End Engineering - React, WRB Tech” role is a hands-on developer role focusing on front-end development, and is accountable for people management and capability development of their Chapter members. Responsibilities in detail are:

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Oversees the execution of functional standards and best practices and provide technical assistance to the members of their Chapter.
  • Responsible for the quality of the code repository where applicable.
  • Acts as a conduit for the wider domain strategy, for example technical standards.
  • Prioritises and makes available capacity for technical debt.
  • This role is around capability building, it is not to own applications or delivery.

Business

  • Experienced practitioner and hands on contribution to the squad delivery for their craft (Eg. Engineering).
  • Responsible for balancing skills and capabilities across teams (squads) and hives in partnership with the Chief Product Owner, Hive Tech Lead & Hive Leadership, and in alignment with the fixed capacity model.
  • Responsible to evolve the craft towards improving automation, simplification and innovative use of latest market trends.

Processes

  • Adopt and embed the Change Delivery Standards throughout the lifecycle of the product / service.
  • Ensure role, job descriptions and expectations are clearly set and periodic feedback provided to the entire team.
  • Follows the chapter operating model to ensure a system exists to continue to build capability and performance of the chapter.
  • Chapter Lead may vary based upon the specific chapter domain its leading.

People & Talent

  • Accountable for people management and capability development of their Chapter members.
  • Reviews metrics on capabilities and performance across their area, has improvement backlog for their Chapters and drives continual improvement of their chapter.
  • Focuses on the development of people and capabilities as the highest priority.

Risk Management

  • Responsible for effective capacity risk management across the Chapter with regards to attrition and leave plans.
  • Ensures the chapter follows the standards with respect to risk management as applicable to their chapter domain.
  • Adheres to common practices to mitigate risk in their respective domain.

Governance

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AI Migration Lead

Principal responsibilities

  • Own the R&C AI portfolio strategy and prioritisation, working closely with the R&C CAIO to translate top-down strategy and target outcomes into an executable, portfolio-level roadmap.
  • Aggregate value and delivery progress from across Value Streams to portfolio level, and instrument the relevant benefit metrics (efficiency & capacity, adoption & maturity) feeding the R&C CAIO's overall benefit-tracking framework.
  • Own the prioritisation and escalation mechanism across Value Streams: chair a regular portfolio prioritisation forum with Value Stream Product Owners and Value Stream AI Leads, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the R&C CAIO.
  • Lead the AI Migration team: a central, flexible technical pool deployed into Value Streams on a solid-line basis to this role, with a dotted-line working relationship into the Value Stream while deployed.
  • Ensure the AI Migration team operates as the bridge between business SMEs and agentic architecture translating and migrating manual or semi-manual tasks into governed, agentic and automated workflows.
  • Partner with Group Technology and the Group AI Platform function, including the Architecture Lead capability, to ensure portfolio delivery aligns to Group tooling, platform and architecture standards.
  • Partner with the Re-engineering team and the Knowledge Management Enablement Lead as shared capabilities supporting the migration agenda.
  • Enable, R&C Value Streams Product Owners and Leads to deliver against set targets.

Requirements

  • Technical leadership: Background in analytics, data, engineering, AI or a closely related technical discipline, with credibility to lead multidisciplinary technical delivery teams. Able to challenge technical approaches, delivery plans, dependencies and trade-offs with credibility.
  • AI-enabled process transformation: Demonstrable experience re-engineering complex business processes and translating them into automation or AI-enabled solutions, ideally within Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime or Controls.
  • Scaled technical delivery: Proven experience leading multiple technical pods across concurrent delivery streams, bringing together engineering, product, data/AI and business SMEs to deliver complex outcomes.
  • Portfolio ownership and prioritisation: Experience owning and prioritising a portfolio of AI, automation or technology opportunities, making decisions across competing demands based on value, feasibility, risk, dependencies and delivery capacity.
  • Agentic AI delivery: Strong practical understanding of agentic AI delivery models, with experience translating business problems into AI use cases and working with engineering teams to move solutions from concept into delivery and adoption.
  • Forward-deployed engineering: Experience of, or strong exposure to, forward-deployed engineering approaches, where technical teams work directly with business SMEs to understand complex workflows and rapidly translate problems into deployable solutions.
  • Risk & Compliance: Strong experience operating with senior stakeholders in Risk & Compliance or a comparable regulated financial services environment, with an understanding of the governance, risk and control considerations surrounding AI delivery.
  • Strategy through execution: Demonstrable ability to operate at both portfolio and technical delivery level, translating AI strategy into a prioritised delivery agenda while remaining sufficiently close to execution to challenge, unblock and accelerate delivery

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help clients gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
  • Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
  • Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review
  • 提供新产品培训，帮助客户获得更好的理财市场信息和解决办法。

  • 帮助客户经理获得并加深客户信任，提高满足客户财务需求的有效性和质量
  • 利用先进的技术专长，加强客户对汇丰在财富管理市场上的领先形象
  • 帮助客户经理梳理客户财务组合，根据市场和政策变化，判断潜在机会并管理风险，对客户持有产品进行相应调整
  • 陪同客户经理约见客人，并基于产品和解决方法提供专业建议
  • 利用专长给客户经理提供辅导和培训
  • 活动包括客户会见及陪同销售、培训、辅导、客户沙龙、客户资产组合回顾及保单回顾等。

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Accumulated extensive working experience as a product specialist or financial advisor or hands-on working experience as Sub-branch Manager in IWPB
  • Strong client skills with the ability to deliver a strong client experience and provide needs-based solutions
  • Deep knowledge of specific complex financial solutions and products including the knowledge of financial markets, social-economic dynamics, and regulatory requirement relevant to the products
  • Extensive external market awareness of market conditions, new product solutions, and an understanding of current financial market activities
  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs
  • Solid skills to manage consultative sales process
  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards
  • Team player with collaborative skills
  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation
  • Specialization in one or more product categories e.g. /Estate Planning/Retirement/Protection/ Education.
  • 相关领域丰富的工作经验，如保险专家或财富管理专家,或有对私支行行长经验
  • 良好客户沟通能力，能基于客户需求提供建议

  • 熟悉外部市场包括市场环境，新产品推出以及对目前产品市场的理解
  • 能够深度挖掘客户需求
  • 熟悉销售流程
  • 熟悉国际反洗钱规则

Job Summary

  • The role exists to ensure integrity, availability, control, and continuous improvement of critical Finance and Treasury data platforms and supporting infrastructure within the GFS Data Management portfolio. The role is accountable for maintaining robust information management capabilities that support financial reporting, regulatory obligations, operational decision-making, and business performance across the Bank.
  • The role develops and executes platform and data management roadmaps, ensuring that data controls, reconciliation processes, validation frameworks, and data quality standards operate effectively and consistently. It serves as the central point of accountability for service stability, infrastructure optimisation, risk management, and operational governance, enabling trusted and timely information for stakeholders.
  • Working across technology, finance, treasury, risk, and operational teams, the role influences strategic improvements to operating models, controls, and service management practices. Success is achieved through resilient information management capabilities, strong stakeholder partnerships, effective risk mitigation, and sustainable processes that support business continuity and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Information Management Strategy & Infrastructure Governance

  • Develop and maintain information management roadmaps that align data infrastructure capabilities with Finance and Treasury business priorities and regulatory requirements.
  • Govern the lifecycle of data management platforms, ensuring infrastructure resilience, scalability, performance, and long-term sustainability.
  • Drive the implementation of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and control frameworks that improve the reliability of critical financial information.
  • Evaluate emerging business requirements and control changes to enhance information management capabilities and service effectiveness.

Data Quality, Controls & Operational Integrity

  • Establish and maintain effective control frameworks that detect, prevent, and remediate data quality, reconciliation, and processing issues.
  • Monitor control effectiveness through metrics, KRIs, KCSAs, testing activities, and governance reviews to strengthen operational integrity.
  • Analyse control weaknesses, exceptions, and recurring issues to implement sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
  • Ensure dispensations, control deviations, and risk events are appropriately assessed, documented, escalated, and managed.

Service Management & Operational Resilience

  • Deliver stable and continuously available information management services through effective service management, monitoring, and operational support models.
  • Design and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience plans to minimise service disruption and data availability risks.
  • Optimise infrastructure performance through proactive monitoring, diagnostics, tuning, and capacity planning activities.
  • Manage configuration controls and operational dependencies to support service reliability and change readiness.

Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with Finance, Treasury, Technology, Risk, and Operations stakeholders to ensure information management services meet business needs.
  • Provide insight-driven recommendations using operational and performance data to support informed decision-making and prioritisation.
  • Communicate service performance, risks, issues, and improvement opportunities through clear governance and reporting mechanisms.
  • Influence stakeholders to drive standardisation, control enhancements, and consistent adoption of information management practices.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

  • Embed regulatory, operational, and conduct risk requirements into information management processes and services.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable policies, governance standards, financial control requirements, and risk management frameworks.
  • Identify, assess, escalate, and mitigate operational, technology, and information risks impacting business services.
  • Maintain effective governance processes that provide transparency, accountability, and assurance over information management activities.

Continuous Improvement & Operating Model Effectiveness

  • Drive process standardisation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, service quality, and control effectiveness.
  • Leverage performance metrics and management information to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Improve operating models through business process re-engineering, automation opportunities, and streamlined control execution.
  • Establish sustainable practices that improve service outcomes while reducing complexity and operational risk.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
  • Configuration Management
  • Infrastructure Optimization
  • Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Progress Reporting
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Strategic Planning

Motivations

  • Motivated by protecting customer and organisational data through practical, proportionate and sustainable privacy solutions.
  • Energised by solving complex risk and control challenges with stakeholders from different business, legal, compliance and technology disciplines.
  • Thrives in environments that value sound judgement, continuous improvement, collaboration and personal accountability.

Qualifications

  • Experience operating in complex financial services environments where data integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience are critical.
  • Exposure to enterprise data management platforms supporting Finance, Treasury, Risk, or regulatory reporting functions.
  • Experience working across technology and business teams to balance service stability, control requirements, and evolving business needs.
  • Exposure to governance frameworks involving risk management, control assessment, service assurance, and operational oversight.
  • Experience leading organisational change, process standardisation, and infrastructure optimisation initiatives in large-scale operating environments.
  • Business English (required)

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

The Salesperson is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Director Salesperson also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Refine and implement sales/marketing strategy to improve Citi's client footprint and maximize associated revenue while working with management/colleagues to establish a clear marketing plan with defined priorities, market penetration and revenue goals
  • Leverage contact network to understand client needs, introduce the Citi offering, and convince clients to adopt it to increase client satisfaction/Citi revenue
  • Advise team in strategic positioning and closing transactions with various internal stakeholders (structuring, trading, legal, credit and risk etc.)
  • Forge a relationship with salespeople in order to leverage Citi's franchise and source relevant buying and selling opportunities for clients
  • Lead strong governance and controls
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
  • Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of sales experience at a financial services organization
  • Experience in a client-facing role working with the buy-side community
  • Proven interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Broad client relationships preferred

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred
  • Working Environment: office setting, minimal travelling and prolonged working hours in the office may be required during projects.
  • Effort: minimal physical effort required. High levels of prolonged and intense concentration may be required in front of computer.
